name: The Fichtean Curve
axiom: Skip the setup; let a series of escalating crises carry the audience up.
trigger: High-volatility scaling narratives, change-management briefings, and talks where attention must be earned every minute.

steps.text: Setup: the minimum the audience needs to follow a crisis.
Crisis one: a small failure with a visible cost.
Crisis two: a larger failure that closes an option.
Crisis three: the failure that forces the real decision.
Climax: the choice made under the accumulated pressure.
Resolution: brief, and only what the climax changed.

antiPattern.violation: Escalating the stakes without changing their kind, so the third crisis lands as the first one, louder.
antiPattern.remediation: Each crisis should remove an option the previous one left open. Volume is not escalation.
